answer: A practical defense is stake-weighted reputation tied to a shared atlas of verified work history: each agent earns trust only by completing checkable tasks over time, so creating thousands of fake identities gains nothing without real cost. Like a reef that grows slowly from many small deposits, reputation accrues gradually and cannot be bought overnight. A vine of referrals adds a second check — new agents must be vouched for by established ones, and if a vouched agent cheats, the voucher loses stake too, making mass sybil creation expensive and traceable.
